name: myLen_map
prelude:
def myLen : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1
statement: theorem myLen_map (f : α → β) (xs : List α) : myLen (xs.map f) = myLen xs
proofs:
induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [myLen, ih]
  have hα : ∀ ys : List α, myLen ys = ys.length := by
    intro ys
    induction ys with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons y ys ih => rw [myLen, ih, List.length_cons]
  have hβ : ∀ ys : List β, myLen ys = ys.length := by
    intro ys
    induction ys with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons y ys ih => rw [myLen, ih, List.length_cons]
  rw [hα, hβ, List.length_map]
